summary: 4 functional and 2 non-functional requirements; 2 ambiguities resolved by assumptions and 0 left open.
decisions: How should the test establish that the second operation is waiting specifically on the target row lock?: Use existing database-native lock-wait visibility where available, or equivalent test-only instrumentation that can identify the second operation as blocked on the target link row. Do not treat a start signal or lack of completion alone as proof. (assumption)

What bounded wait should be used to observe lock contention?: Use the test suite’s existing timeout convention; if none exists, use a finite, appropriately generous test timeout. Expiration must fail the test with a diagnostic and must not permit the first operation to commit as though the interleaving had been proven. (assumption)
